title: Flaky test: contextAssembler bounds character chronicle records
description: packages/core/test/contextAssembler.test.ts > 'bounds character chronicle records in assembled context' failed once on CI for docs-only PR #400 (run 28773134507, job 85310992499, 2026-07-06) with an ordering-looking deep-equal mismatch on ['Portable memory 1.', ...]; the same commit's push-event CI run and local runs pass (18/18). Likely order/seed-dependent selection of chronicle records. Investigate determinism of the bounding/selection; do not just rerun-until-green.
notes: Root cause: listRecords/listEvents tiebroke updated_at/occurred_at ties on TEXT id columns (record_id/event_id), which sort lexicographically ('chronicle-10' < 'chronicle-2'). Fixed to tiebreak on rowid (insertion order), matching scene.ts's getLastDmOutput pattern. Added deterministic regression test with fixed clock. PR: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/432
close_reason: Merged in PR #432 (commit 7fbbaef on main): fixed listRecords/listEvents to tiebreak on rowid instead of the TEXT id column, eliminating the lexicographic-sort flakiness.
